_comment: Role-family -> Soliyog's generic 'what this kind of role usually tests' lines + one 'why worth a look' hook. Matched loosely against the job title (lowercased). No match -> the poster/caption omits the 'Soliyog's read' block rather than inventing intel.

tests: SQL — joins, window functions, one messy-data cleanup
A metrics case: pick the number, then defend it
data analyst.read: Fresher-friendly analyst roles are the fastest way into data — SQL + clear thinking beats a CS degree here.

tests: A case: structure the problem, pick a number, defend it
Attention to detail on a data task
analyst.read: Analyst roles reward structured thinking and clean work over fancy tooling — a solid fresher entry point.

tests: Requirements: turn a vague ask into a spec
business analyst.read: BA roles reward structured thinking over tooling — good first step if you like problems more than code.

tests: DSA — arrays, strings, hashmaps, one medium problem
Language fundamentals + a small debugging task
A project walkthrough — what you built and why
software|developer|engineer|sde|programm.read: Fresher SWE roles still hinge on DSA + one solid project you can explain end to end.

tests: ML basics: train/test split, overfitting, a metric choice
Explain a model you've actually built
data scien|machine learning|ml engineer|.read: Entry ML roles want practical Python and honest project stories, not paper-level theory.

accountant|accounts|finance exec|bookkee.read: Accounting roles are steady entry points in finance — Tally + Excel + GST basics get you in the room.

tests: Value a company and defend the number
Explain a stock you'd buy and why
equity research|research analyst|investm.read: Research roles test whether you can defend a view under pressure — not just build the model.

tests: A scenario: handle an upset customer / stuck process
support|customer success|operations asso.read: Ops and support roles are underrated first jobs — they teach you how a business actually runs.
